summary: Second round after the in-window fix round: both majors (ratified text; confirmation enqueued with translator clock) and all four minors closed. Approve, risk low.
notes: First round: revise, functional_risk medium — 2 majors (non-ratified confirmation text propagated to protocol doc; confirmation enqueued with inbound origin timestamp, unrecoverable after offline backlog > TTL because the single claim was already spent) + 4 minors (portero.go unformatted — none of the 7 verify commands covers Go formatting; sentinel header lost its self-protection clause; AC-5 test name promised a sqlstore rebuild it never performed; new exported symbols undocumented).

Reviewer re-ran gates itself on the final diff: go vet clean, go test -count=1 green on all six sidecar packages, go test -race green on canal/identidad/outbox; contract-check ok=true 0 violations (forbid.behaviors only not_checked); acceptance-coverage pass, AC-1..AC-6 covered, 0 gaps. Final diff 15 files, +1263/-49 (1312 lines vs amended 1350).

ORCHESTRATOR CONTRACT AMENDMENT flagged for the human at the merge gate: limits.max_diff_lines 1250->1350 and per_class traduccion.go 110->125, amended AFTER seeing the diff. Adjudicated acceptable, not violation-laundering: motivated and dated inline + contract_amendment trace event; touch/forbid/verify/acceptance untouched; overrun corresponds to review-mandated work (clock seam + ~75-line anti-regression test).

Declared no-dead-wiring exception holds: PorteroDeSalida.Admitir has no core-side producer until plan task 3's socket server (debt in STATUS.md); fully implemented, wired in main.go, test-covered, structurally guarded by the extended sentinel.

Known operational risk (info): AdmitirConfirmacionDeBaja claims before enqueuing — if Encolar fails the claim is spent and the confirmation is lost permanently (log line only). Consistent with the at-most-once bias declared in the blueprint.
Gate gap noted for future contracts: no verify command covers Go formatting (only cargo fmt --check for Rust); consider adding a gofmt -l check to the sidecar verify command.
